brief:
Gaza's scholarship recipients confront obstacles that extend far beyond winning their places, the Palestine News Network reported. Students cite uncontrollable circumstances including physical injuries, changes to their appearance, and the unavailability of accessible language testing within the territory as significant impediments to pursuing their awards.

The challenges reflect broader systemic constraints within Gaza that complicate educational advancement even after students have achieved the competitive milestone of securing scholarships.
dek: GAZA / PNN / By Farah Samer Zaina Saadeddin “My injury wasn’t in my control. The changes in my appearance weren’t in my control. The lack of accessible language tests in Gaza is out of my control.
title: Gaza scholarship winners face barriers beyond acceptance
